column2: You must start Step 1 - Check Preliminary HDB Flat Eligibility (HFE) afresh if there are any changes to the details you have provided. You will not be able to make any changes after you have submitted your HFE letter application. If you need to make changes, you must cancel your HFE letter application and apply for a fresh one.

column1: Complete Steps 1 and 2 within 30 calendar days of each other
